title: Reach starts open and narrows from observed use
situation: The agents model holds reach by the harness's permissions. The re-cut's master design set tight tool ceilings for every role before any role had been used under them. The operator, 2026-10-10: limiting agents to specific tools is the tuned end of a mature design; restricting first, without evidence of what a role never needs, makes initial work too restrictive.
decision: Every agent starts with the harness's default tools. Reach is held as a setting only where the design itself rules a tool out: the assayer, which never repairs, has no tool that changes anything, and each agent dispatches exactly its handoffs. Each role's perception and action scopes describe its purpose, not a restriction. They are narrowed later, from the tools each role is observed to use across cuts, never ahead of that evidence (as least-privilege policies are generated from access logs).
consequences: The re-cut's master design and example 8 are amended before its build starts. Decision 0045's reach ceiling for the architect describes its purpose until evidence narrows it, so the journal capability taking over version control is no longer a precondition for launching the architect.
